headline: 5 dress watches from $3,000 to $6,000
stop_reason: Stopped before rendering (attempt 3). (1) Prices: no brand or official retailer price page dated November 2026 was confirmed for any dress-watch pick. The search returned only WatchCharts (aggregator, dated Oct/Nov on secondary-market figures), jaztime and other undated retailer listings, and Bucherer list prices with no date. Per the lesson, the pick cannot be priced from a dated official source. (2) Photos: state/permissions.json lists only Rockstar Games, and the asset library has no rights-cleared photo for Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Ultra Thin (find returned no matches). No other pick was found with a rights-cleared photo. Also, Master Ultra Thin prices fall well above the $3,000-$6,000 band on official retailer pages (Bucherer steel $12,900), so this price band does not match the current references. Suggested next step: owner to add a permissions entry or brand press photos for dress-watch models, and allow a fresh idea with a price band that matches current official pricing.
